notes: Delete of a derived fact (as literature_arts-replace-0016): the chain housed_in o located_in ⊑ located_in and transitivity re-derive it, so each world forgets one movable premise; The Hague's country is firm. q3 ('in the same country') is a join over named individuals; the Rijksmuseum in the Netherlands, and in no other country, is its bridge (firm). Relabelled dl on 2026-10-31 (COVERAGE.md label corrections); the fol section keeps its Z3 encoding as a second check.

girl: Vermeer's Girl with a Pearl Earring

queries.ask: mauritshuis : located_in some (Country and inv(located_in) value rijksmuseum)

fol.notes: located_in is a transitive relation and housed_in a function (RELATIONS.md); the premise 'an artwork is located in the country where its museum stands' is the catalogued chain housed_in o located_in (museum_chain). The Hague's country, the chain, transitivity and 'a place lies in one country' are firm, as in the DL file. 'The same country' asks for a country both museums are in. Named places are an enumeration; the worlds' placeholders are constants of the same sort. Delete of a derived fact: each world forgets one movable premise (w1 the painting's museum, w2 the Mauritshuis's city).

girl_maur.says: Vermeer's Girl with a Pearl Earring hangs in the Mauritshuis. (premise)

maur_hague.says: The Mauritshuis is in The Hague. (premise)

hague_nl.says: The Hague is in the Netherlands. (premise)

rijks_nl.says: The Rijksmuseum is in the Netherlands. (stored)

museum_chain.says: An artwork is located in the country where the museum that holds it stands. (premise)
museum_chain.z3: ForAll([x, m, c], Implies(And(housed_in(x) == m, located_in(m, c)), located_in(x, c)))

transitive.z3: ForAll([x, y, z], Implies(And(located_in(x, y), located_in(y, z)), located_in(x, z)))

countries.says: The Netherlands and Brazil are countries.

one_country.says: A place lies in only one country.
one_country.z3: ForAll([x, c, d], Implies(And(country(c), country(d), located_in(x, c), located_in(x, d)), c == d))

queries.ask: Exists(c, And(country(c), located_in(mauritshuis, c), located_in(rijksmuseum, c)))
